            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202608/3633603-20260801005958162-3147897.png" alt="[最优化技术] 3-5 牛顿法与阻尼牛顿法" class="desc_img">
        本文详细介绍多元函数无约束优化中的牛顿法与阻尼牛顿法。该方法利用目标函数的二阶导数信息（Hessian矩阵）构造二次近似，通过求解线性方程组确定搜索方向，具有二阶收敛速度。文章系统阐述了Hessian矩阵的性质、牛顿法的迭代公式及其几何意义，并通过手算实例展示了二次函数一步收敛的特性。针对标准牛顿法的局限性，引入阻尼牛顿法通过一维搜索确定最优步长，提高了算法的全局收敛性与稳定性。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1><center>3-5 牛顿法与阻尼牛顿法</center></h1>
<h2 id="牛顿法">牛顿法</h2>
<h3 id="简述">简述</h3>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>牛顿法（Newton's Method）是一种利用目标函数的二阶导数信息（Hessian矩阵）进行优化的方法。与最速下降法仅使用一阶梯度信息不同，牛顿法通过二次泰勒展开近似原函数，能够更准确地预测极值点的位置，因此具有更快的收敛速度（二阶收敛）。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>牛顿法的基本思想是：在当前点处用二次函数近似原目标函数，然后直接求出该二次函数的极小值点作为下一次迭代点。</p>
<h3 id="原理">原理</h3>
<p>对于多元函数 <span class="math inline">\(f(X)\)</span>，在点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k)}\)</span> 处进行二阶泰勒展开：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X) \approx f(X^{(k)}) + [\nabla f(X^{(k)})]^T (X - X^{(k)}) + \frac{1}{2}(X - X^{(k)})^T H(X^{(k)}) (X - X^{(k)})
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(H(X^{(k)})\)</span> 为 <strong>Hessian矩阵</strong>（海森矩阵）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H(f) = \left(\begin{array}{cccc}
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1^2} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1 \partial x_2} &amp; \cdots &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1 \partial x_n} \\
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2 \partial x_1} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2^2} &amp; \cdots &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2 \partial x_n} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_n \partial x_1} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_n \partial x_2} &amp; \cdots &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_n^2}
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>注意</strong>：当函数的所有二阶混合偏导数连续时，有 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_i \partial x_j} = \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_j \partial x_i}\)</span>，即 <strong>H矩阵对称</strong>。对于多项式函数，Hessian矩阵必然对称。</p>
<p>对于<strong>二次函数</strong>求极值，令泰勒展开的一阶导数为零：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(k)}) + H(X^{(k)}) (X - X^{(k)}) = 0
\]</div><p></p><p>解得<strong>牛顿法迭代公式</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\boxed{\; X^{(k+1)} = X^{(k)} - [H(X^{(k)})]^{-1} \nabla f(X^{(k)}) \;}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="hessian矩阵的性质">Hessian矩阵的性质</h3>
<p>Hessian矩阵的正定性决定了极值点的性质：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>正定</strong>（所有特征值 &gt; 0）→ 局部极小点</li>
<li><strong>负定</strong>（所有特征值 &lt; 0）→ 局部极大点</li>
<li><strong>不定</strong>（有正有负特征值）→ 鞍点</li>
<li><strong>半定</strong>（有零特征值）→ 需要高阶检验</li>
</ol>
<p>对于<strong>二元二次函数</strong>，Hessian矩阵为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H = \left(\begin{array}{cc}
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1^2} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1 \partial x_2} \\
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2 \partial x_1} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2^2}
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>二阶矩阵求逆公式</strong>：对于矩阵 <span class="math inline">\(A = \left(\begin{array}{cc} a &amp; b \\ c &amp; d \end{array}\right)\)</span>，当 <span class="math inline">\(ad - bc \neq 0\)</span> 时：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A^{-1} = \frac{1}{ad-bc} \left(\begin{array}{cc} d &amp; -b \\ -c &amp; a \end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="牛顿法分析">牛顿法分析</h3>
<p><strong>特点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>原函数为<strong>二次函数</strong>：一步求出极值点。</li>
<li>原函数为<strong>非二次函数</strong>：先通过二阶泰勒展开变为二次函数，因此求出的为极值点的近似值。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>优点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>收敛速度最快（二阶收敛）</li>
<li>对于二次函数，一次迭代即可收敛</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>缺点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>Hessian矩阵计算困难（需要计算所有二阶偏导数）</li>
<li>Hessian矩阵求逆计算量大</li>
<li>当Hessian矩阵不正定时，可能不收敛或收敛到鞍点</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="具体步骤">具体步骤</h3>
<p>对于给定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)}\)</span> 和收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>① 确定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)}\)</span>，收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>，令 <span class="math inline">\(k=0\)</span>；</li>
<li>② 计算梯度 <span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span> 和 Hessian矩阵 <span class="math inline">\(H(X^{(k)})\)</span>；</li>
<li>③ 判断Hessian矩阵是否正定。若不正定，可采用修正策略（见阻尼牛顿法）；</li>
<li>④ 构造搜索方向 <span class="math inline">\(d^{(k)} = -[H(X^{(k)})]^{-1} \nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span>；</li>
<li>⑤ 更新迭代点：<span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)} = X^{(k)} + d^{(k)}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(k=k+1\)</span>；</li>
<li>⑥ 重复②~⑤步，直到：<span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f(X^{(k)})\| \le \varepsilon\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="实例计算">实例计算</h3>
<p>这里我们举个例子，手把手带大家使用牛顿法，一步步来计算一个二元二次凸函数的最优解。</p>
<h4 id="题目">题目</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X) = x_1^2 + 2x_2^2 - 4x_1 - 2x_1 x_2,\;\; X^{(0)} = [1,1]^T,\;\varepsilon = 0.01
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="解答">解答</h4>
<p>首先计算 <span class="math inline">\(f(X)\)</span> 的梯度函数和Hessian矩阵：</p>
<p><strong>梯度</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X) = 
\left(\begin{array}{c}
2x_1 - 2x_2 -4 \\
-2x_1 + 4x_2
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>Hessian矩阵</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H(X) = \left(\begin{array}{cc}
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1^2} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_1 \partial x_2} \\
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2 \partial x_1} &amp; \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_2^2}
\end{array}\right) = \left(\begin{array}{cc}
2 &amp; -2 \\
-2 &amp; 4
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>注意</strong>：对于二次函数，Hessian矩阵为常数矩阵，不随 <span class="math inline">\(X\)</span> 变化。</p>
<p>代入 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)} = [1,1]^T\)</span>，得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(0)}) = 
\left(\begin{array}{c}
2(1) - 2(1) -4 \\
-2(1) + 4(1)
\end{array}\right) = 
\left(\begin{array}{c}
-4 \\
2
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>计算梯度的模长：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|\nabla f(X^{(0)})\| = \sqrt{(-4)^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5} \approx 4.47 &gt; \varepsilon
\]</div><p></p><p>不满足收敛条件，迭代继续。</p>
<p><strong>第 1 次迭代 (<span class="math inline">\(k=0\)</span>)：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>计算Hessian矩阵的逆：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H = \left(\begin{array}{cc}
2 &amp; -2 \\
-2 &amp; 4
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>行列式：<span class="math inline">\(\det(H) = 2 \times 4 - (-2) \times (-2) = 8 - 4 = 4\)</span></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H^{-1} = \frac{1}{4} \left(\begin{array}{cc}
4 &amp; 2 \\
2 &amp; 2
\end{array}\right) = \left(\begin{array}{cc}
1 &amp; 0.5 \\
0.5 &amp; 0.5
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><ol start="2">
<li>计算牛顿方向：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d^{(0)} = -H^{-1} \nabla f(X^{(0)}) = -\left(\begin{array}{cc}
1 &amp; 0.5 \\
0.5 &amp; 0.5
\end{array}\right) \left(\begin{array}{c}
-4 \\
2
\end{array}\right) = -\left(\begin{array}{c}
-4 + 1 \\
-2 + 1
\end{array}\right) = \left(\begin{array}{c}
3 \\
1
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><ol start="3">
<li>更新迭代点：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^{(1)} = X^{(0)} + d^{(0)} = \left(\begin{array}{c}
1 \\
1
\end{array}\right) + \left(\begin{array}{c}
3 \\
1
\end{array}\right) = \left(\begin{array}{c}
4 \\
2
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><ol start="4">
<li>检验收敛条件：<br>
计算 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(1)}\)</span> 处的梯度：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(1)}) = 
\left(\begin{array}{c}
2(4) - 2(2) - 4 \\
-2(4) + 4(2)
\end{array}\right) = 
\left(\begin{array}{c}
0 \\
0
\end{array}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>梯度的模长：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\|\nabla f(X^{(1)})\| = 0 &lt; \varepsilon
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>满足收敛条件，迭代结束！</strong></p>
<p>最终得到最优解：<span class="math inline">\(X^* = X^{(1)} = [4, 2]^T\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(f(X^*) = 4^2 + 2 \times 2^2 - 4 \times 4 - 2 \times 4 \times 2 = 16 + 8 - 16 - 16 = -8\)</span></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>结论</strong>：当目标函数 <span class="math inline">\(f(X)\)</span> 为二次函数时，二阶泰勒展开是精确的，而其中的Hessian矩阵 <span class="math inline">\(\nabla^2f(X^{(k)})\)</span> 是一个常数矩阵。因此从任意初始点进行迭代，只需一步迭代即可找到目标函数的极小值点。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="代码示例">代码示例</h3>
<details open="">
<summary>牛顿法 C++ 代码示例：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">// 牛顿法 求多元函数最小值点（支持任意维度）
// func: 目标函数
// grad: 梯度函数
// hess: Hessian矩阵函数
// x0: 初始点（向量）
// eps: 收敛精度
vector&lt;double&gt; newton_method(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; func,
    function&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; grad,
    function&lt;vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; hess,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x0,
    double eps,
    int max_iter = 1000
) {
    vector&lt;double&gt; x = x0;
    int n = x0.size();
    
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n迭代过程:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "步骤\t点 X\t\t\t函数值 f(X)\t\t梯度范数" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "-----------------------------------------------------------------" &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    for (int iter = 0; iter &lt; max_iter; ++iter) {
        // 1. 计算当前点的梯度
        vector&lt;double&gt; g = grad(x);
        
        // 2. 计算梯度范数 ||∇f(X)||
        double grad_norm = norm(g);
        
        // 3. 检查收敛条件
        if (grad_norm &lt; eps) {
            cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
            for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
                printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
                cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
            }
            printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf (收敛)\n", func(x), grad_norm);
            break;
        }
        
        // 4. 计算Hessian矩阵
        vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt; H = hess(x);
        
        // 5. 求解 H * d = -g （使用高斯消元法或直接求逆）
        vector&lt;double&gt; d = solve_linear_system(H, g);
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
            d[i] = -d[i];  // d = -H^(-1) * g
        }
        
        // 6. 更新迭代点 X^(k+1) = X^(k) + d^(k)
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            x[i] += d[i];
        }
        
        // 打印迭代信息
        cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
            cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
        }
        printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\n", func(x), grad_norm);
    }
    
    return x;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h2 id="阻尼牛顿法">阻尼牛顿法</h2>
<h3 id="问题与改进">问题与改进</h3>
<p>标准牛顿法存在以下问题：</p>
<ol>
<li>当Hessian矩阵不正定时，搜索方向可能不是下降方向</li>
<li>步长固定为1，可能导致函数值不降反升</li>
<li>初始点远离极值点时，可能不收敛</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>阻尼牛顿法</strong>（Damped Newton's Method）通过引入一维搜索来确定最优步长，解决了上述问题。</p>
<h3 id="阻尼牛顿法迭代公式">阻尼牛顿法迭代公式</h3>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^{(k+1)} = X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)} \cdot d^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(d^{(k)} = -[H(X^{(k)})]^{-1} \nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span> 为牛顿方向</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)}\)</span> 通过一维搜索确定，使 <span class="math inline">\(f(X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)} d^{(k)})\)</span> 最小，<span class="math inline">\(\alpha\)</span> 也称为阻尼因子。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="具体步骤-1">具体步骤</h3>
<p>对于给定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)}\)</span> 和收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>① 确定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)}\)</span>，收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>，令 <span class="math inline">\(k=0\)</span>；</li>
<li>② 计算梯度 <span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span> 和 Hessian矩阵 <span class="math inline">\(H(X^{(k)})\)</span> 以及其逆矩阵 <span class="math inline">\([H(X^{(k)})]^{-1}\)</span>；</li>
<li>③ 构造搜索方向 <span class="math inline">\(d^{(k)} = -[H(X^{(k)})]^{-1} \nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span>；</li>
<li>④ <strong>一维搜索</strong>：求最优步长 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)}\)</span>，使 <span class="math inline">\(f(X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)} d^{(k)})\)</span> 最小；</li>
<li>⑤ 更新迭代点：<span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)} = X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)} \cdot d^{(k)}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(k=k+1\)</span>；</li>
<li>⑥ 重复②~⑤步，直到：<span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f(X^{(k)})\| \le \varepsilon\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="程序框图">程序框图</h3>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202608/3633603-20260801005349517-968535087.png" alt="阻尼牛顿法的程序框图" style="zoom: 80%">
<h3 id="代码示例-1">代码示例</h3>
<details open="">
<summary>阻尼牛顿法 C++ 代码示例：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">// 阻尼牛顿法 求多元函数最小值点
vector&lt;double&gt; damped_newton_method(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; func,
    function&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; grad,
    function&lt;vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt;&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; hess,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x0,
    double eps,
    int max_iter = 1000
) {
    vector&lt;double&gt; x = x0;
    int n = x0.size();
    
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n迭代过程:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "步骤\t点 X\t\t\t函数值 f(X)\t\t梯度范数\t步长" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "--------------------------------------------------------------------" &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    for (int iter = 0; iter &lt; max_iter; ++iter) {
        // 1. 计算当前点的梯度
        vector&lt;double&gt; g = grad(x);
        
        // 2. 计算梯度范数
        double grad_norm = norm(g);
        
        // 3. 检查收敛条件
        if (grad_norm &lt; eps) {
            cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
            for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
                printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
                cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
            }
            printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\t\t(收敛)\n", func(x), grad_norm);
            break;
        }
        
        // 4. 计算Hessian矩阵
        vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt; H = hess(x);
        
        // 5. 求解牛顿方向 d = -H^(-1) * g
        vector&lt;double&gt; d = solve_linear_system(H, g);
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
            d[i] = -d[i];
        }
        
        // 6. 定义一维搜索函数 phi(alpha) = f(x + alpha * d)
        auto phi = [&amp;](double alpha) {
            vector&lt;double&gt; new_x(x.size());
            for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
                new_x[i] = x[i] + alpha * d[i];
            }
            return func(new_x);
        };
        
        // 7. 使用进退法+黄金分割法确定最优步长 alpha
        pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket;
        try {
            bracket = bracket_minimum(phi, 0.0, 0.1);
        } catch (...) {
            printf("[Warning] bracket minimum failed! bracket = [0, 10]\n");
            bracket = make_pair(0.0, 10.0);
        }
        
        double alpha_star = golden_section(phi, bracket.first, bracket.second, eps);
        
        // 8. 更新迭代点 X^(k+1) = X^(k) + alpha* * d^(k)
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            x[i] += alpha_star * d[i];
        }
        
        // 打印迭代信息
        cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
            cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
        }
        printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\n", func(x), grad_norm, alpha_star);
    }
    
    return x;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="完整示例">完整示例</h3>
<details>
<summary>C++代码实现（完整）：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;vector&gt;
#include &lt;cmath&gt;
#include &lt;functional&gt;
#include &lt;iomanip&gt;
#include &lt;utility&gt;

using namespace std;

// 计算向量范数
double norm(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; v) {
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (double vi : v) {
        sum += vi * vi;
    }
    return sqrt(sum);
}

// 进退法求初始区间
pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket_minimum(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double a0, double h) {
    const int MAX_ITER = 1e4;
    if (h &lt;= 0)
        throw invalid_argument("Step size h must be positive.");
    
    if (func(a0) &lt;= func(a0 + h)) {
        double x0 = a0 + h, x1 = a0;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 - h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER)
                throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded in left expansion");
            x0 = x1;
            x1 = x2;
            h *= 2;
            x2 = x1 - h;
        }
        return make_pair(x2, x0);
    } else {
        double x0 = a0;
        double x1 = a0 + h;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 + h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER)
                throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded in right expansion");
            x0 = x1;
            x1 = x2;
            h *= 2;
            x2 = x1 + h;
        }
        return make_pair(x0, x2);
    }
}

// 黄金分割法 求最小值点（横坐标）
double golden_section(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double l, double r, double eps) {
    double a = l, b = r, aa, bb;
    while (b - a &gt; eps) {
        aa = b - 0.618 * (b - a);
        bb = a + 0.618 * (b - a);
        if (func(aa) &lt; func(bb))
            b = bb;
        else
            a = aa;
    }
    return (a + b) / 2;
}

// 求解线性方程组 H * x = b （高斯消元法）
vector&lt;double&gt; solve_linear_system(vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt; H, vector&lt;double&gt; b) {
    int n = b.size();
    
    // 增广矩阵
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
        H[i].push_back(b[i]);
    }
    
    // 高斯消元
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
        // 找主元
        int max_row = i;
        for (int k = i + 1; k &lt; n; ++k) {
            if (abs(H[k][i]) &gt; abs(H[max_row][i])) {
                max_row = k;
            }
        }
        
        // 交换行
        swap(H[i], H[max_row]);
        
        // 消元
        for (int k = i + 1; k &lt; n; ++k) {
            double factor = H[k][i] / H[i][i];
            for (int j = i; j &lt;= n; ++j) {
                H[k][j] -= factor * H[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 回代
    vector&lt;double&gt; x(n);
    for (int i = n - 1; i &gt;= 0; --i) {
        x[i] = H[i][n];
        for (int j = i + 1; j &lt; n; ++j) {
            x[i] -= H[i][j] * x[j];
        }
        x[i] /= H[i][i];
    }
    
    return x;
}

// 阻尼牛顿法
vector&lt;double&gt; damped_newton_method(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; func,
    function&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; grad,
    function&lt;vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; hess,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x0,
    double eps,
    int max_iter = 1000
) {
    vector&lt;double&gt; x = x0;
    int n = x0.size();
    
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n迭代过程:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "步骤\t点 X\t\t\t函数值 f(X)\t\t梯度范数\t步长" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "--------------------------------------------------------------------" &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    for (int iter = 0; iter &lt; max_iter; ++iter) {
        vector&lt;double&gt; g = grad(x);
        double grad_norm = norm(g);
        
        if (grad_norm &lt; eps) {
            cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
            for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
                printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
                cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
            }
            printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\t\t(收敛)\n", func(x), grad_norm);
            break;
        }
        
        vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt; H = hess(x);
        vector&lt;double&gt; d = solve_linear_system(H, g);
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
            d[i] = -d[i];
        }
        
        auto phi = [&amp;](double alpha) {
            vector&lt;double&gt; new_x(x.size());
            for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
                new_x[i] = x[i] + alpha * d[i];
            }
            return func(new_x);
        };
        
        pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket;
        try {
            bracket = bracket_minimum(phi, 0.0, 0.1);
        } catch (...) {
            printf("[Warning] bracket minimum failed!\n");
            bracket = make_pair(0.0, 10.0);
        }
        
        double alpha_star = golden_section(phi, bracket.first, bracket.second, eps);
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            x[i] += alpha_star * d[i];
        }
        
        cout &lt;&lt; iter &lt;&lt; "\t";
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) {
            printf("%.6lf", x[i]);
            cout &lt;&lt; (i == x.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
        }
        printf("\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\t\t%.6lf\n", func(x), grad_norm, alpha_star);
    }
    
    return x;
}

// ==========================================================
// 示例：二元二次凸函数
// f(X) = x1^2 + 2*x2^2 - 4*x1 - 2*x1*x2
// ==========================================================

int main() {
    cout &lt;&lt; "阻尼牛顿法求解多元函数极小值" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数: f(X) = x1^2 + 2*x2^2 - 4*x1 - 2*x1*x2" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "理论最优解: X* = [4.0, 2.0]^T, f(X*) = -8.0" &lt;&lt; endl &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    // 目标函数
    auto f = [](vector&lt;double&gt; x) {
        return x[0] * x[0] + 2 * x[1] * x[1] - 4 * x[0] - 2 * x[0] * x[1];
    };
    
    // 梯度函数
    auto grad = [](vector&lt;double&gt; x) {
        vector&lt;double&gt; g(2);
        g[0] = 2 * x[0] - 2 * x[1] - 4;
        g[1] = 4 * x[1] - 2 * x[0];
        return g;
    };
    
    // Hessian矩阵函数
    auto hess = [](vector&lt;double&gt; x) {
        vector&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;&gt; H(2, vector&lt;double&gt;(2));
        H[0][0] = 2;   // ∂²f/∂x1²
        H[0][1] = -2;  // ∂²f/∂x1∂x2
        H[1][0] = -2;  // ∂²f/∂x2∂x1
        H[1][1] = 4;   // ∂²f/∂x2²
        return H;
    };
    
    double x1_init, x2_init, eps;
    cout &lt;&lt; "输入初始点 x1: ";
    cin &gt;&gt; x1_init;
    cout &lt;&lt; "输入初始点 x2: ";
    cin &gt;&gt; x2_init;
    cout &lt;&lt; "输入精度 eps: ";
    cin &gt;&gt; eps;
    
    vector&lt;double&gt; x0 = {x1_init, x2_init};
    vector&lt;double&gt; result = damped_newton_method(f, grad, hess, x0, eps);
    
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n最终结果:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "最优解 X* = [";
    for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; result.size(); ++i) {
        cout &lt;&lt; result[i] &lt;&lt; (i == result.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; "]^T" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数值 f(X*) = " &lt;&lt; f(result) &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    vector&lt;double&gt; final_grad = grad(result);
    double final_norm = norm(final_grad);
    cout &lt;&lt; "最终梯度范数 = " &lt;&lt; final_norm &lt;&lt; endl;
    
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h3 id="总结">总结</h3>
<h4 id="牛顿法与阻尼牛顿法的比较"><strong>牛顿法与阻尼牛顿法的比较</strong>：</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>牛顿法</th>
<th>阻尼牛顿法</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>步长</td>
<td>固定为1</td>
<td>通过一维搜索确定</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>收敛性</td>
<td>局部收敛，要求初始点靠近极值点</td>
<td>全局收敛性更好</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>计算量</td>
<td>较小（无需一维搜索）</td>
<td>较大（需一维搜索）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>适用场景</td>
<td>二次函数或初始点较好时</td>
<td>一般情况，更稳健</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h4 id="牛顿法的优缺点">牛顿法的优缺点：</h4>
<p><strong>优点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>收敛速度最快（二阶收敛）</li>
<li>对于二次函数，一次迭代即可收敛到精确解</li>
<li>充分利用了函数的二阶信息</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>缺点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>需要计算Hessian矩阵（所有二阶偏导数）</li>
<li>需要求解线性方程组或矩阵求逆，计算量大</li>
<li>当Hessian矩阵不正定或奇异时，可能不收敛</li>
<li>对初始点要求较高（标准牛顿法）</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="阻尼牛顿法的改进">阻尼牛顿法的改进：</h4>
<ol>
<li>通过一维搜索确定最优步长，保证了函数值下降</li>
<li>具有更好的全局收敛性</li>
<li>即使初始点远离极值点，也能稳定收敛</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>适用场景</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>目标函数的二阶导数容易计算</li>
<li>对收敛速度要求较高</li>
<li>问题规模适中（Hessian矩阵不太大）</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>一般地，将牛顿法和阻尼牛顿法统称为牛顿型方法。牛顿型方法总体上迭代次数较少、计算速度较快。但是这类方法的主要缺点是每次迭代都要计算函数的二阶导数矩阵，并对该矩阵求逆。当目标函数的维数高时，算量和存储量大的缺点尤为明显。最速下降法的收敛速度比牛顿型方法慢，而牛顿型方法又存在上述缺点。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>至此，我们已经介绍了两种基于梯度信息的优化方法：最速下降法原理简单但收敛较慢，牛顿法收敛速度快但需要计算Hessian矩阵。在接下来的文章中，我们将首先介绍<strong>坐标轮换法</strong>——一种无需计算梯度的直接搜索方法，它通过沿坐标轴方向依次搜索来寻找极值点，实现更为简单。之后，我们将介绍<strong>共轭梯度法</strong>，它巧妙地结合了最速下降法和牛顿法的优点，既避免了Hessian矩阵的计算，又克服了最速下降法的锯齿现象，具有较快的收敛速度。</p>
<hr>
<p>本学习笔记参考资料：</p>
<p>[1] 白清顺, 孙靖民, 梁迎春. 机械优化设计 第7版[M]. 北京: 机械工业出版社, 2024. ISBN: 978-7-111-75103-8</p>
<p>[2] 武汉理工大学《最优化技术B》课程课件，授课教师：颜彬老师</p>
